一场罕见的，历史上从来没有过的大地震在戈壁滩上爆发了。地震的结果是出现了一条世界上最大最深的裂缝。
半年后，一个由多国组成的探险队向着裂缝地深处探险。但是一场突然爆发的地火，烧死了大部分的探险者，剩下了人也在慌乱之中失去了联系。
在地火爆发的一刹那，许紫烟不知道被谁一把推到了一个山洞之中。那个山洞之内是一个陡峭的滑坡，许紫烟一路翻滚着滑落下去，不知道滑落了多长时间，到最后她已经失去了知觉。
隐隐约约的哭泣声将许紫烟惊醒，眼皮沉沉的睁不开。耳边却传来一个女子的哭泣声，和一个男子悲痛的叹气声。
许紫烟的头很痛，她使劲地回想着发生的事情。她记得自己从山洞一直翻滚而下，最后自己失去了知觉。模糊中当自己恢复意识的时候，自己好像躺在一个广场上，在自己的面前是一个高大的女子塑像，然后那个女子塑像的双目突然发出了光芒，照射在自己的身上，自己的意识里就突然多出了“传承”的东西，然后自己就又晕了过去。
那么，现在自己是在哪里？那个哭泣的女子和叹气的男子又是谁？
许紫烟想要睁开眼睛，可是浑身没有一丝力气，酝酿了半天，才微微地将眼皮睁开了一条缝。屋子里很昏暗，看不清东西，只是隐隐约约地看到一个中年女子坐在自己的面前，低着头哭泣着。
“吱呀”一声，许紫烟感觉到门开了。接着一团暗影闪了进来，然后是一个苍老的声音道：
“许光，如今紫烟已经死了，按照族里的规矩，分给紫烟的那三亩地明天就交给族里吧。”
刚才那个叹息的男子低声地说道：“就按村长说地办吧！”
“唉~”
那个苍老的声音长叹了一声，摇了摇头，转身离开了房间。
“紫烟？还姓许？和我一个名字？说得是我吗？”
许紫烟的脑海中突然涌出了一些记忆碎片，那是一段不属于自己的记忆。读完了那些记忆之后，许紫烟知道自己穿越了，穿越在一个十五岁的少女的身上。
这片大陆不同于自己来自的那个世界，是一个修真的世界。自己附身的这个少女也叫作许紫烟，许家是修真大陆上的一个超级家族。不过超级家族自然有着超级家族的悲哀，许紫烟的父母都是不能够修炼的人，自然地位也就十分地低下，只能够在远离家族中心，非常偏远的村子里生活。而到了这样的村子之后，基本上就是被家族放弃了。就是后代出了一个能够修炼的人，也没有人关心，同样也没有人知道，谁又会关心没有灵根的凡人的后代呢？
记忆中是那个许紫烟过桥时，被一条大黄狗所惊，掉下了水。被救上来时已经死了，没想到却被自己的灵魂附上了身。这么一会儿，许紫烟已经恢复了一些力气，缓缓地睁开了双眼。微微地转了一下脖子，便看到了床前哭泣的中年女子和不远处坐在一张椅子上的中年男子。
许紫烟转头带动了身下那张破旧的床，床板“吱呀”地响了一声，惊动了哭泣的中年女子。那中年女子向许紫烟一望，身体就是一僵，过了半晌，才轻声地唤道：
“烟儿？”
许紫烟的心中一阵尴尬，她不知道如何称呼眼前的人，只好费劲地咧了咧嘴，露出一丝笑容。

“烟儿！”
那中年女子一下子扑到了许紫烟的身上，紧紧地抱着许紫烟，放声大哭。这一哭，哭得天昏地暗，撕心裂肺。也哭得许紫烟满腹辛酸，整个心都碎了。前世在地球的时候，许紫烟是一个孤儿，没有体验过父母地疼爱。如今被眼前的女子抱着这么一哭，让她感觉到了对方那发自心底的疼爱，眼睛也禁不住湿润了起来。
“烟儿！”
那个男子不知道什么时候已经站在了床前，一双大手不住地颤抖着，脸上老泪纵横。
许紫烟被两人哭得一阵阵心酸，刚想要开口安慰几句。却是身体虚弱的很，两眼一翻，又晕了过去。
待再次醒来，迷迷糊糊中被人喂着喝了一碗粥，便又迷迷糊糊地晕了过去。再一次醒来，天已大亮。
屋子里静悄悄的，想是许紫烟的爹娘都下地干活了吧。许紫烟挣扎着从床上下了地，感觉到身体已经恢复了很多。举目向着四周望去，心中便是一片苦涩。屋子里什么也没有，只有一张破床，一看就是十分地穷困。抱着希望，许紫烟推开房门走了出去，到对面的屋子里看了看，同样的空空如也。此时，许紫烟的心中只余下了四个字：一贫如洗。

A rare and unprecedented earthquake occurred in the Gobi Desert. The result of the earthquake was the creation of one of the largest and deepest cracks in the world.
Half a year later, a multinational expedition team explored the depths of the fissure. But a sudden underground fire burned most of the explorers to death, and the remaining people lost contact in the panic.
The moment the ground fire broke out, Xu Ziyan was pushed into a cave by someone unknown. There was a steep landslide inside the cave. Xu Ziyan rolled and slid all the way down. She didn't know how long she fell. In the end, she lost consciousness.
The faint sound of crying woke Xu Ziyan up, and his eyelids were so heavy that he could not open them. A woman's cry and a man's sad sigh could be heard in his ears.
Xu Ziyan's head hurt, and she tried hard to recall what happened. She remembered tumbling down the cave until she lost consciousness. When he regained consciousness in the blur, he seemed to be lying in a square. In front of him was a tall female statue, and then the eyes of the female statue suddenly emitted light and shone on him. Something about "inheritance" suddenly appeared in his consciousness, and then he fainted again.
So, where are you now? Who are the crying woman and the sighing man?
Xu Ziyan wanted to open her eyes, but she didn't have any strength. After brewing for a long time, she opened her eyelids slightly. The room was very dark and he could not see clearly. He could only vaguely see a middle-aged woman sitting in front of him, her head lowered and crying.
With a "squeak", Xu Ziyan felt the door open. Then a dark shadow flashed in, and then an old voice said:
"Xu Guang, now that Zi Yan is dead, according to the clan's rules, the three acres of land allocated to Zi Yan will be handed over to the clan tomorrow."
The man who sighed just now said in a low voice: "Just do what the village chief said!"
"Alas~"
The old voice sighed, shook his head, turned and left the room.
"Zi Yan? Your surname is Xu? The same name as mine? Are you talking about me?"
Some memory fragments suddenly emerged in Xu Ziyan's mind, which was a memory that did not belong to him. After reading those memories, Xu Ziyan knew that he had traveled through time and was in the body of a fifteen-year-old girl.
This continent is different from the world he came from. It is a world of cultivation. The girl he possesses is also called Xu Ziyan. The Xu family is a super family on the continent of cultivation. However, a super family naturally has the sorrow of a super family. Xu Ziyan's parents are both people who cannot cultivate, so their natural status is very low, and they can only live in very remote villages far away from the family center. After arriving in a village like this, he was basically abandoned by his family. Even if there is a person in the future who can cultivate, no one cares, and no one knows about it. Who will care about the descendants of mortals who have no spiritual roots?
The memory is that when Xu Ziyan was crossing the bridge, he was frightened by a big yellow dog and fell into the water. He was already dead when he was rescued, but unexpectedly he was possessed by his own soul. After a while, Xu Ziyan had recovered some strength and slowly opened his eyes. Turning his neck slightly, he saw a middle-aged woman crying in front of the bed and a middle-aged man sitting on a chair not far away.
Xu Ziyan turned her head and moved the shabby bed underneath her. The bed board made a "squeak" sound, alarming the crying middle-aged woman. The middle-aged woman looked at Xu Ziyan and her body froze. After a while, she softly called out:
"Yan'er?"
Xu Ziyan felt embarrassed. She didn't know how to call the person in front of her.The person had no choice but to grin and show a smile.
"Yan'er!"
The middle-aged woman suddenly threw herself on Xu Ziyan, hugged Xu Ziyan tightly, and cried loudly. This crying made the sky dim and the earth dark, and it was heartbreaking. Xu Ziyan also cried so much that she was filled with bitterness and her whole heart was broken. When she was on Earth in her previous life, Xu Ziyan was an orphan and had never experienced the love of her parents. Now being held by the woman in front of her and crying like this, she felt the love from the bottom of her heart, and her eyes couldn't help but become moist.
"Yan'er!"
The man didn't know when he was standing in front of the bed, his big hands trembling, and tears streaming down his face.
Xu Ziyan was heartbroken by the two crying, and just wanted to say a few words of comfort. But he was very weak. He rolled his eyes and fainted again.
When he woke up again, he was fed a bowl of porridge in a daze, and then he fainted again. When I woke up again, it was broad daylight.
The room was quiet, I guess Xu Ziyan's parents were working in the fields. Xu Ziyan struggled to get off the bed and felt that her body had recovered a lot. He raised his eyes and looked around, feeling bitter in his heart. There was nothing in the house except a shabby bed, which showed that he was very poor at first glance. With hope, Xu Ziyan opened the door and walked out. He looked in the opposite room and found it was equally empty. At this time, Xu Ziyan only had four words left in his heart: penniless.
